title: Michael Jordan’s 1998 Bulls jersey sells for record $14 million to Miami investor
summary_full: A historic Michael Jordan jersey from the 1998 NBA Finals has been sold for an astonishing $14 million. This sale sets a new benchmark in the world of basketball collectibles, emphasizing the increasing importance of sports memorabilia in popular culture. With its autograph and verified ownership, the jersey's value soared, especially as interest in Jordan's last championship season continues to grow, attracting avid collectors and investors alike.
